<!--
  ============================================================
  HOW THIS WORKS (this note is a real HTML comment now — it's
  invisible on the page, not printed as text like last time)
  ============================================================
  Markup + Swiper.js init live here; visual styling lives in your
  shared styles.scss under "Tick Identification Carousel".

  HOW TO ADD A SPECIES:
    Each card is one <div class="swiper-slide"> ... </div> block,
    marked with SLIDE START / SLIDE END comments. Copy a whole
    block (both markers included), paste it AFTER an existing
    SLIDE END and BEFORE the next SLIDE START — as a sibling,
    never inside another slide's tags — then edit the image path,
    title, and the two placeholder paragraphs.

  ⚠️ CONTENT IS PLACEHOLDER. Species facts should come from your
  own research/citations, not guessed.
-->
<div class="tick-id-wrap">
  <div class="swiper tick-swiper">
    <div class="swiper-wrapper">

      <!-- SLIDE START -->
      <div class="swiper-slide">
        <img src="images/ticks/PLACEHOLDER-deer-tick.jpg" alt="Blacklegged (deer) tick">
        <div class="tick-card-body">
          <h3>Blacklegged Tick</h3>
          <p>PLACEHOLDER — replace with a verified species description (size, color, distinguishing features).</p>
        </div>
        <div class="tick-card-location">
          <span class="tick-pin">&#128205;</span>
          <p>PLACEHOLDER — replace with verified range/habitat info.</p>
          <a href="tick-borne-diseases.qmd" class="tick-read-more">READ MORE</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- SLIDE END -->

      <!-- SLIDE START -->

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
  new Swiper('.tick-swiper', {
    centeredSlides: true,
    slidesPerView: 'auto',
    spaceBetween: -30,
    slideToClickedSlide: true,
    grabCursor: true,
    rewind: true,   // jump back to the first slide after the last (and vice versa)
    navigation: {
      nextEl: '.tick-swiper .swiper-button-next',
      prevEl: '.tick-swiper .swiper-button-prev',
    },
  });
</script>
